title: CNC Coolant Low-Level Warning
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cnc:coolant
| stats latest(level_pct) as level_pct by machine
| where level_pct<20
| sort level_pct
description: Uses CNC coolant telemetry telemetry to monitor remaining coolant level on each machine in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for machines that may soon run too hot or dirty, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest CNC coolant telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It flags remaining coolant level on each machine so you can spot machines that may soon run too hot or dirty before it becomes annoying.
